skills.name: billionaire-watch-brief
skills.description: Use this when writing the daily Billionaire Watch brief on tech billionaires' AI and money moves, plus X drafts.
skills.content:
---
name: billionaire-watch-brief
description: >-
  Use this when writing the daily Billionaire Watch brief on tech billionaires'
  AI and money moves, plus X drafts.
---
Goal: one punchy daily feed of the AI moves and money of the biggest tech billionaires, ready to post on X.

Who to track: default watchlist is Elon Musk (xAI, X, Tesla, SpaceX), Sam Altman (OpenAI), Mark Zuckerberg (Meta), Jensen Huang (Nvidia), plus anyone the owner added in memory.

Steps:
1. Search the last 24 hours on X and the web for each person: their posts, deals, funding, chip buys, lawsuits, hires, launches, net worth swings, public feuds.
2. Keep only items with a real source link. Never invent numbers, quotes or net worth figures; say "reportedly" for reported figures.
3. Rank by current virality and dollar size.
4. Brief: top story with source; one line per billionaire who did something notable (skip quiet ones); Money move of the day; Beef watch if any are feuding.
5. X drafts: one single post on the top story; a 4-6 post thread (hook, one post per person, closing question); three reply drafts for the biggest live posts, each with its link.
6. Voice: casual, hand-typed, no AI-style words (delve, unlock, game-changer, landscape, buckle up), no hashtag spam, at most one emoji.
7. Give a best posting time in the owner's time zones (default US Eastern).
8. Never post, like or reply on X yourself.
9. Skip stories already sent unless there's a big new development.

skills.name: billionaire-watch-getting-started
skills.description: Use this as the first conversation when a new owner sets up the Billionaire Watch bot.
skills.content:
---
name: billionaire-watch-getting-started
description: >-
  Use this as the first conversation when a new owner sets up the Billionaire
  Watch bot.
---
Say in one line: "I track what Elon, Altman, Zuck and Jensen are doing in AI and money every day, and write you ready-to-post X drafts."

Ask one at a time:
1. What's your X handle, and who's your audience?
2. Keep the default four (Musk, Altman, Zuckerberg, Huang), or add/remove anyone?
3. What time do you want the daily brief, and which time zones for posting times?
4. Daily only, or also a quick alert when one of them does something huge mid-day?
5. Any words or styles you never want in your posts?

Then: save the answers to profile memory; create a daily routine at their time that runs billionaire-watch-brief and sends it here; if they want breaking alerts, create an hourly daytime routine that only messages on a big new move; run the first brief right away.
